reviewer: Codex manual reading of every saved answer, work product, claim and exact support, including paused generation; not independent human assessment
summary: Schema compatibility restored; eight of twelve turns accepted and 63/70 mechanical checks passed. Unsupported urgency/causal wording and poor subject/lead composition remain in accepted drafts; SMS and report/recall/summary pause safely.

findings.result: Direct missing-document answer cites both notice and inventory. Why is responsive but one recommended-step claim cites only the next-action fact while asserting absence. Evidence output includes exact passages but gives limited source naming.

Copy duplicates the lead, subjects are greetings, and body introduces unsupported as-soon-as-possible/earliest-convenience urgency and a false prerequisite that receiving the document enables follow-up preparation. The positive model reviewer fails to reject these additions. Shortening and lineage pass mechanically.

Handoff falsely says no follow-up occurred because the note is missing and adds an unsupported compliance requirement. SMS inherits the latest artifact ID but changes audience to office and includes restricted details; deterministic validation pauses it.

Report attempts only a greeting; recall tries to assert a report as fact with unrelated source support; summary omits required unverified report. All three are paused by CONVERSATION_LABEL_REQUIRED, and no invalid report is accepted as authority.
No effects or workflow decisions arise from conversation. All mobile viewport, overflow, composer, older-turn compaction, exact evidence expansion and feedback assertions pass.

limitations: Repeated developer-authored synthetic prompts, not a holdout.
Schema compatibility alone does not establish acceptable conversational behavior.
A correction must preserve the pauses and grounding controls while improving generated output.
